title: Use Drilldown to investigate without a query

blocks.content: Dashboards show what someone already thought to watch. When checkout latency doubles and no saved page covers it, you need to find out what just changed. That's what Drilldown is for. Start with Metrics, Logs, Traces, or Profiles, click filters, and narrow down until you've found the spike. You don't write a query. In Grafana Cloud, this is how you hunt when you don't yet know what you're looking for.
First, open Drilldown and start with Metrics:
Click **Drilldown** in the main menu. Four sections: **Metrics**, **Logs**, **Traces**, and **Profiles**.
Click **Metrics**, the numbers recorded over time. Every metric appears as a chart, before you ask for anything.
You started with Metrics, and Drilldown showed every metric it has. No query written.
Next, narrow the view down to one thing:
Click **Select** on the first metric. The view narrows to that one metric, broken down by its labels.
blocks.tooltip: One click narrows from everything to one thing. The breakdown that opens splits it further, one chart per label.

blocks.content: This is a **filter**: pick a label and a value, and every chart narrows to match. Clicking filters is the whole workflow.
blocks.tooltip: Each pick narrows the result. Stack a few and you've cornered the problem, without writing a query.

blocks.content: A spike in the numbers often has a matching error in the logs. **Related logs** jumps from this metric to those text records.
blocks.tooltip: A spike in the numbers often has a matching error waiting in the logs.

blocks.content: Start from everything, narrow with clicks, jump to the matching logs. That's an investigation in Grafana Cloud, and you never wrote a query.
